'''Hauke Harder''' (born 1963 in [[Heide]] ([[Holstein]]), Germany) is a German [[composer]]<ref name="museen-nord.de">[http://www.museen-nord.de/ml/kultur.news/x/index.php?s=1&t=&gui=mb2&rubrik=880&kat=10?h=0&e=3942 Konzerte zur Ausstellung "Klangraum Flensburg"] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110614121101/http://www.museen-nord.de/ml/kultur.news/x/index.php?s=1&t=&gui=mb2&rubrik=880&kat=10%3Fh%3D0&e=3942 |date=14 June 2011 }}</ref> and experimental [[physicist]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.komponisten.kulturnetz-sh.de/content/komponist_zeigen0.php?kid=2|title=Hauke Harder at Kulturnetz Schleswig-Holstein|access-date=12 January 2022}}{{Dead link|date=July 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://haukeharder.net/publikation_wiss.html|title=Publikationen Moleküspektroskopie|website=haukeharder.net|access-date=12 January 2022}}</ref>

== Life ==
Harder received a PhD in chemistry, and works at the Institute for Physical Chemistry, Department of Chemistry and Physics, [[University of Kiel]], [[Kiel, Germany]].

In 1989, he studied with [[Wolfgang von Schweinitz]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://iem.at/services/events/events_2007/opencube0708/harder.pdf|title=Hauke Harder, Three Lines and a Walk, Nicht-Lineares in Arbeiten von Alvin Lucier und Hauke Harder|access-date=12 January 2022}}</ref> a [[New Simplicity]] composer.

He is the founder, (with Rainer Grodnick) of the "Gesellschaft für Akustische Lebenshilfe", (Society for Musical Living Assistance), [[Kiel, Germany]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.kiel.de/kultur/stadtgalerie/show_stadtgalerie.php?id=142 |title=Stadtgalerie Kiel, 2002 |access-date=10 June 2006 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081021183153/http://www.kiel.de/kultur/stadtgalerie/show_stadtgalerie.php?id=142 |archive-date=21 October 2008 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | url=http://home.snafu.de/djwolf/Acoustical%20living%20assistance.htm | title=Acoustical living assistance: An agenda for the next few millennia}}</ref>  Since 1995, he has worked as an assistant to composer [[Alvin Lucier]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.thing-hamburg.de/index.php?id=955|title=Thing Hamburg, January 2008|access-date=12 January 2022|archive-date=19 July 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110719093524/http://www.thing-hamburg.de/index.php?id=955|url-status=dead}}</ref> and is associated with the Material group of composers,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://materialpress.com/harder.htm|title=Hauke Harder|website=materialpress.com|access-date=12 January 2022}}</ref> along with [[Daniel James Wolf]], and [[Markus Trunk]].  His compositional work is in an extreme minimal style,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://home.snafu.de/djwolf/harder.htm|title=Hauke Harder|website=home.snafu.de|access-date=12 January 2022}}</ref> and is connected to the work of the composers [[Morton Feldman]], [[Walter Zimmermann]], and [[Alvin Lucier]]. His music has also been influenced by [[Monochrome Painting]] and the films of [[Robert Bresson]].

His work in sound installation, exhibitions and concerts include: the International New Music Festival [[Rümlingen, Switzerland]], Evenings of New Music [[Bratislava]], Flanders Music Festival [[Antwerp]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.efa-aef.eu/newpublic/?p=calendar&q=event&id=6980&-session=s:42F947EF0a739211CEkRI107D210 |title=European Festivals Association |access-date=6 May 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081221140452/http://www.efa-aef.eu/newpublic/?p=calendar |archive-date=21 December 2008 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Nové Expozice hudby [[Brno]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.enh.mhf-brno.cz/enh2006e.php |title=Expozice nov? Hudby |access-date=6 May 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110718180040/http://www.enh.mhf-brno.cz/enh2006e.php |archive-date=18 July 2011 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://zither7-de.translate.goog/harder.html?_x_tr_sl=de&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en|title=Zither 7 - Hauke Harder|website=zither7-de.translate.goog|access-date=12 January 2022}}</ref>

== Awards ==
In 2001 he received a "Kulturnetz-Preis", and 3,000 Mark, by [[Schleswig-Holstein]]'s culture minister Ute Erdsiek-Rave.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.infomedia-sh.de/_media/infomedia-sh_aktuell_02_01.rtf|title=Infomedia Aktuell, 02/01, page 27|access-date=12 January 2022}}</ref>

== Works ==
His works as a scientist in the field of molecular spectroscopy have been featured in:
* {{cite journal| journal=Molecular Physics|volume=86 | issue=1 | date=September 1995 | pages=107–124|author1=Hauke Harder |author2=Helmut Dreizler |author3=Duan Papouek | doi = 10.1080/00268979500101871 | title=The direct l -type resonance spectrum of CF 35 3 Cl in its vibrational state v 6 = 1|bibcode=1995MolPh..86..107H }} 
* {{cite journal| title=Direct l-type doubling transitions in the ν6 = 1 vibrational state of CF3Br and CF3I: l-type resonance effects on the spin-rotation coupling| journal=Chemical Physics Letters | doi=10.1016/0009-2614(96)00399-5 | volume =255| issue= 4–6| date=14 June 1996| pages=287–294 |author1=Carsten Gerke |author2=Hauke Harder | bibcode=1996CPL...255..287G }}, 
* {{cite journal | last1=Macholl | first1=Sven | last2=Mäder | first2=Heinrich | last3=Harder | first3=Hauke | last4=Margulès | first4=Laurent | last5=Dréan | first5=Pascal | last6=Cosléou | first6=Jean | last7=Demaison | first7=Jean | last8=Pracna | first8=Petr | title=Rotational Spectrum of NSF3 in the Ground and v5 = 1 Vibrational States: Observation of Q-Branch Perturbation-Allowed Transitions with Δ(k − l) = 0, ±3, ±6 and Anomalies in the Rovibrational Structure of the v5 = 1 State | journal=The Journal of Physical Chemistry A | publisher=American Chemical Society (ACS) | volume=113 | issue=4 | date=5 January 2009 | issn=1089-5639 | doi=10.1021/jp807342f | pages=668–679| pmid=19123852 | bibcode=2009JPCA..113..668M }} 
* {{cite journal| title=Hyperfine structure of rotational transitions of 14NF3 in the v4 = 1 vibrational state| journal=Journal of Molecular Spectroscopy| volume=230| issue=1| date=March 2005| pages=99–101 |author1=Ulf Wötzel |author2=Hauke Harder |author3=Heinrich Mäder |author4=Luciano Fusina | doi=10.1016/j.jms.2004.10.003| bibcode=2005JMoSp.230...99W}}
* {{cite book | last=Harder | first=H. | title=Untersuchungen an symmetrischen Kreiselmolekülen mittels ein- und zweidimensionaler Fouriertransform-Spektroskopie im Radiofrequenz- und Mikrowellenbereich | year=1993 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=UxQnHQAACAAJ | language=de | access-date=12 January 2022}}

== Performances ==
[[Hildegard Kleeb]] has premiered his work.<ref name="Mode Records">{{cite web | title=Hildegard Kleeb – Mode Records | website=Mode Records | url=https://moderecords.com/composers/hildegard-kleeb/ | access-date=12 January 2022}}</ref> On 14 April 2009, his piece in honor of [[Walter Zimmermann]] was played in concert by [[Heather O'Donnell]].<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://concerts.heatherodonnell.info/ | title=Heather o'donnell, schedule}}</ref>  He is in the Czech New Music Group MoEns' repertoire.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.musica.cz/moens/index.html |title=Ensemble MoEns |access-date=6 May 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071026085441/http://www.musica.cz/moens/index.html |archive-date=26 October 2007 |url-status=dead }}</ref>  [[Roland Dahinden]] has premiered his work.<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.roland-dahinden.ch/biography | title=Roland Dahinden}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.dramonline.org/albums/roland-dahinden-silberen/notes | title=DRAM: Notes for "Roland Dahinden: Silberen"}}</ref>  On 26 April 2008, Trio Nexus played his work at ''festival blurred edges'', Hamburg.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.trio-nexus.de/en/arch_konz_konz.html |title=Trio Nexus - Past Performances |access-date=6 May 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110622065527/http://www.trio-nexus.de/en/arch_konz_konz.html |archive-date=22 June 2011 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Criticism ==
<blockquote>Hauke Harder is both a composer and physicist, Blake and Newton in one person, if you will. This fact is something that Harder has always presented as essentially accidental. This fact has sometimes made composers and musicians a bit nervous, suspicious of the program behind his programs. A large part of this nervousness is surely just the anxiety most citizens feel about science: they do not understand it but believe it to be true. This is just a modern substitute of the fear of God felt by all of our ancestors. In truth, though, Harder’s vision should rather make physicists nervous: his is an assertion that the aesthetic, with qualities incomprehensible to the rational eye and ear, also has a part, indeed the vital part, in the life of the mind.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://home.snafu.de/djwolf/Acoustical%20living%20assistance.htm|title=Acoustical living assistance: An agenda for the next few millennia|access-date=12 January 2022}}</ref></blockquote>

* {{cite book| title= Punto e Basta: Hauke Harder / Stephan Ullmann | author=Knut Nieves, [[Wolfgang von Schweinitz]]| publisher=Kulturamt d. Landeshauptstadt Kiel; Stadtgalerie im Sophienhof | location=Kiel | year=1996| isbn=978-3-927979-43-7 }}
